name: Eyebrawl
biography: Oculotyrannus manus. A pugilist beholder-kin — a floating eye with massive fists whose punches leave targets coated in volatile slime that detonates in one of six random ways at the next blunt hit. Habitat: The Low & Urban.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
features.description: If the eyebrawl fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The eyebrawl makes three Volatile Punch attacks.

features.name: Volatile Punch
features.description:
Melee Weapon Attack: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target isn't already coated with volatile slime, it becomes coated. The slime can be washed off as an action with 1 gallon of water. The next time the coated target takes Bludgeoning damage, the slime burns away violently and the target suffers one of the following effects (roll 1d6; reroll if the eyebrawl has already used that effect since the start of its last turn):

  1. Igniting Slime. The target takes 3 (1d6) Fire damage.
  2. Corrosive Slime. The target takes 5 (2d4) Acid damage.
  3. Concussive Slime. The target takes 4 (1d8) Thunder damage and its Speed is halved until the end of its next turn.
  4. Forceful Slime. The target takes 3 (1d6) Force damage and is pushed 15 feet in a random direction, landing Prone.
  5. Blinding Slime. The target takes 4 (1d8) Radiant damage and is Blinded until the end of its next turn.
  6. Explosive Slime. The target takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage and each creature within 5 feet of it takes 2 (1d4) Fire damage.

features.name: Headbutt
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Intimidation Cone
features.description: The eyebrawl's eye emits an intimidating presence in a 60-foot Cone. Until the start of the eyebrawl's next turn, creatures in the area are Frightened of the eyebrawl.

features.name: Charge (Legendary Action)
features.description:
Legendary Action Uses: 2. Immediately after another creature's turn, the eyebrawl can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The eyebrawl regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

The eyebrawl flies up to its Fly Speed and makes one Headbutt attack.

features.name: Deck 'Em (Legendary Action)
features.description: The eyebrawl makes one Volatile Punch attack.
